name: MathBench
description: MathBench is a hierarchical mathematics benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' proficiency in both theoretical understanding and practical application across a wide range of mathematical disciplines, from basic arithmetic to college-level mathematics.
typical_sota_score: varies by difficulty: roughly ≈80–95% on basic/undergraduate tasks and ≈40–70% on advanced/graduate-level problems for recent top LLMs
reputation: A newer math benchmark that has seen some use in LLM evaluation, but it is less established than long-running suites like MATH or GSM8K.
notes: Covers five stages from basic arithmetic to college math; bilingual context; evaluates theory and application.
